versioningPolicy.sourceFiles: Stable paths; revisions are recorded in Git history.
versioningPolicy.releaseIdentity: A Git tag identifies the exact repository commit for a release.
versioningPolicy.generatedEvidence: Attach immutable, release-specific reports and a release manifest to the GitHub Release; do not commit renamed copies of source files.
versioningPolicy.renames: Preserve the stable artifactId when an artifact is renamed or moved. Record the new path in the catalogue in the same change.
